## Experimental source-only preview

This is the first Avelin **prerelease**, not a production-ready Linux optimizer. GitHub's source archives are the only downloads; there are no DEB, Flatpak, Arch or AppImage installers in this release.

Includes a native GTK 4 prototype, CPU/RAM history, system information, seven reversible GNOME preferences, detected power-profile selection, a bounded read-only storage audit, manually confirmed permanent trash deletion, and informational GitHub release checks.

**Important:** Back up important data first. Emptying trash is permanent and may include supported mounted volumes. Storage scan sizes are approximate and not necessarily reclaimable. No packages, logs, caches or app data are deleted by the scan. GPU metrics, zram configuration, desktop switching, self-updating and packaging are not implemented. GUI testing across actual distributions and hardware is still required. See the README and roadmap before running from source.
